classifications: Mathematics of computing → Graphs and surfaces
Theory of computation → Graph algorithms analysis
statement: We raise the following open questions: (i) How many bends are needed for achieving quadratic area RAC drawings? We showed that three are insufficient and that eight are enough. (ii) Is cubic area optimal for RAC3 drawings? Our lower bound proof might be extendable. (iii) Is quadratic area achievable in simple RAC drawings? In simple drawings, every pair of edges shares at most one point (crossing or endpoint); a property our algorithms do not guarantee.
